**ROC Curve**

-   Try all thresholds

    -   get curve and look for TPR FPR intersection

    -   45 degree curve kind of corresponds to the intercept only curve

-   Area Under the Curve (AUC)

    -   Perfect is an AUC of 1, .5 = random, 0 = worse than random

    -   AUC is not percent correct – its false and true positive
